name: POLYFORGE Asset Baker
description: Enforces triangle budgets with deterministic topology-guarded edge collapse, bakes ordered LODs to self-contained glTF binaries, and derives runtime descriptors from exported-file readback. Rejects impossible budgets, folded or duplicate faces, non-manifold collapses, corrupt GLBs, and descriptor drift rather than silently shipping over-budget output. Offline baking only; presentation.lod_system remains the runtime selector.

implementations.note: Deterministic LOD reduction, GLB encoding, byte/triangle/socket readback, strict budget failures, and independent Python rebake validation.

inputs.name: strictBudgets
inputs.description: Fail when topology guards cannot reach a declared ceiling.

outputs.name: assetDescriptor
outputs.description: Runtime asset contract with measured GLB triangles and bytes.

outputs.name: lodFiles
outputs.description: Self-contained glTF 2.0 binary payloads per declared level.

provenance: Library-native offline baking foundation built for original POLYFORGE geometry; deterministic reduction, GLB encoding, and independent readback are new implementation work.
